aiSettings.validationMore: …and {{n}} more — see the red text below
aiSettings.serverValidationMore: …and {{n}} more — see the red text below
aiSettings.chatModelTip: Title generation, document summaries, AI chat and AutoLink entity extraction all use this model.
aiSettings.embeddingModelTip: Converts text into vectors for semantic search (understands similar meanings and synonyms). Without it, search falls back to pure keyword matching.
aiSettings.reuseChatConnection: Reuse the chat model's connection (shared baseUrl + apiKey)
aiSettings.disabledFallbackKeyword: Disabled (config kept, falls back to keyword search)
aiSettings.rerankerModelTip: Re-ranks the mixed-search results so the most relevant notes surface first. Optional.
aiSettings.semanticIndexTip: Automatically generates vector indexes when notes are written or updated; this powers semantic search. Includes image understanding and vector store status.
aiSettings.entityGraphTip: Extracts people, concepts, and other entities from notes for the Entities page and graph. Uses the Chat model, separate from vector search.
aiSettings.visionDescription: When enabled, images in documents get a text description generated during indexing and are included in semantic search (each image costs one vision-model call; image content is sent to the configured AI provider).
aiSettings.vectorStaleWarning: Model changed · old vectors excluded from search · please rebuild
aiSettings.cancelRebuildSent: Stop requested — will stop after the current batch
aiSettings.entityRebuildCostHint: Calls Chat in batches (~every 32 blocks). Large libraries are slow and use tokens.
aiSettings.entityIndexEmpty: Entities not built yet — graph is empty
aiSettings.autoLinkTip: After writing a note, automatically extracts key concepts and links notes when confidence is high enough; low-confidence ones are silently skipped — no manual review.
aiSettings.webSearchTip: When the knowledge base lacks an answer, AI can fetch supplementary info from Brave Search; results are marked with 🌐 to distinguish them from note citations [n].

diagnose.autolinkChatDown: Dependency Chat unreachable — auto-linking won't trigger
